notes: No SM section describes this case. Every row comes from SM 2.2 rules 4, 6 and 9, 2.3, 2.4, 5.1 and 5.2 as docs/errata/2026-11-22-relayed-prompts.md applies them. Nothing is credited, so no second has a level; evidence C is agent-day's, the other case that credits nothing.

An agent in another T3 thread sends this thread its message through T3's MCP tools, and T3 stores it with createdBy agent, so the T3 reader writes no relay record. Nothing witnesses the prompt, and rule 4, which lists parent_class agent_app, makes it headless whatever window hosts the session. headless_prompts counts it; relayed_prompts and typed_prompts count none.

Lena types in T3's window with key presses in every slot, and the window, which hosts the session and resolves to weather-cli, is in front throughout. No presence or focus code applies, so an uncredited second is X.automated while the headless turn runs and X.no_anchor otherwise. No human anchor exists, so nothing reads the bucket and no second is X.bucket_cap.

Rule 6 at the prompt's t would hold: a key press 0.7 s before it, T3's window hosting the session in front, and 240 characters, plausible over 285 s of input. Without agent_app on rule 4's list, with T3's window as the session's desktop-app host, the prompt would be human_typed at level A, and the case would credit 395 s: P 280, SUP 95 and READ 20. README.md works it out minute by minute.
